C-ABSENCE-VALUE.Summary: Unify absence values with issueClass (catalog-derived), teach doctor to report the two codes it can see by reason, and land one shared verdict vocabulary under skills.
C-ABSENCE-VALUE.Problem: Three absence codes already ship (analysis.no-adapter, analysis.runtime-missing, assertion.command-not-evaluated), but consumers must enumerate them by name. Doctor filters analysisIssues with an analysis. prefix and a Pick that would drop issueClass (A3.2 §2, A4.3). Skills have no shared vocabulary for review / AC / verification outcomes the binary does not own. Nested-template fixture markers still defeat the quote stripper (corpus-re-03). Setting issueClass only at NgraceIssue emission sites cannot reach lint: addNgraceIssue re-copies five fields (A5.1). Default current-mode lint skips unevaluated command assertions rather than reporting assertion.command-not-evaluated, so doctor never sees that code (A5.2; A4.3 consequence 2 withdrawn). Route 2 requires an exact catalog entry for the third code; the assertion. prefix guide must never carry issueClass (A6.1).

Goals.Goal: Additive optional issueClass on LintIssue so absence is one recognizable class without renaming codes (schemaVersion stays 1.0.0).

Route 2 (A5.1): derive issueClass from exact catalog entries only inside withLintIssueGuide. Catalog is the single classification source. assertion.command-not-evaluated gains an exact catalog entry (A6.1). Prefix guides and the synthesized fallback never set issueClass — uncatalogued codes are defects by default (A6.1 §2–3). analysis.adapter-failed (defect branch of project-utils.ts:330 ternary) is not absence (A3.2 §1).

Doctor reports absences by reason via issueClass for the two analysis.* codes it can reach; pure partition over LintIssue[] unit-tested for all three codes; third code classified under lint --assertions target against a durable fixture (not C-ABSENCE-VALUE) (A5.2, A6.2, A6.3). No new doctor flags.
One shared verdicts.md fragment; single-source rule scoped to repository-root skills/ only (A3.2 §3); fails on deliberate duplication.
Scanner treats nested-template markers as non-markup; corpus-re-03 lands; corpus-zo-03 attempted honestly.
Drop-site inventory for LintIssue/NgraceIssue and per-surface reachability of each absence code reported (A5.4, A5.9).

Constraints.Constraint: No rename or removal of existing issue codes; issueClass is optional and additive.
Classification route is A5.1 route 2 (exact catalog entry + withLintIssueGuide), not route 1 (widen NgraceIssue / addNgraceIssue).
issueClass may be set on exact catalog entries only — never on a prefix guide (A6.1 §2).
Do not add assertion-mode or run-commands flags to doctor (A5.2).
No new runtime dependencies; no Phase 3+ constructs (run-ledger, cursor, gates, provenance attributes).
scripts/ stays ignored; adoption is its own C-*. Measure un-ignored error count before and after (A4.2).
skills/ngrace/* is source of truth; packaged plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/* must stay byte-identical and is excluded from the single-source token scan (A3.2 §3).
proposedBy is typed against the D4 PatternId union without importing src/test-support into src/lint/ (A3.2 §4).
AffectedAreas derived from the traced code path, not only from §2.3's provisional file table (A5.6).
Tests and measurements must not depend on transient artifact state (A6.4); fixture bundles only.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Transition gates, run ledger, cursor, attempt log, or review automation (Phases 3–6).
Adopting scripts/ or creating M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION (separate C-*).
Renaming absence codes or inventing a second reason field parallel to the code string.
Adding START_MODULE_CONTRACT markup to src/ files (Path-only graph ownership remains deliberate and thin).
Widening NgraceIssue or changing addNgraceIssue for issueClass (route 1 rejected in favor of route 2).
Making doctor observe assertion.command-not-evaluated under current mode (A5.2; skip is deliberate).
File→module ObservedWriteScope cross-check (A5.7; recorded for a later phase).
Pinning third-code evidence to live C-ABSENCE-VALUE (A6.2; use fixtures).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ISSUE-CLASS: issueClass exists on LintIssue as optional additive field. The three absence codes (analysis.no-adapter, analysis.runtime-missing, assertion.command-not-evaluated) each have an exact catalog entry with issueClass "absence" and carry it after withLintIssueGuide (A6.1). The defect branch of the project-utils.ts:330 ternary, analysis.adapter-failed, is not "absence" (A3.2 §1). A non-absence assertion.* code (e.g. assertion.MustExist) carries no absence class — prefix guide must not classify (A6.1 §2). Uncatalogued codes default to no class / defect (A6.1 §3). Visible in lint --format json for codes that lint actually emits.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DOCTOR-ABSENCE: Doctor reports absences by reason via issueClass (not code.startsWith("analysis.")) for the two codes reachable under current mode: analysis.no-adapter and analysis.runtime-missing (A5.2). Zero case on this repository is attributed to current-mode skip of unevaluated MustPassCommand/MustPassBudget (lint/core.ts:238-244, :290-297; pinned grace-lint.test.ts:410 and :1080) — not to missing wiring (A5.2 §1). Non-zero doctor case from a fixture governing an extension no adapter supports (codeExtensions: [".ex"]). assertion.command-not-evaluated is classified and tested where reachable: unit partition over LintIssue[] for all three codes, plus one lint-level test under --assertions target against a durable fixture bundle (extend grace-lint.test.ts C-COMMAND fixture at :399-417; A6.2, A6.3) — not against live C-ABSENCE-VALUE. Reported as classified, unreachable from doctor today (A5.2 §2). No doctor flags added.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CATALOG-JUSTIFY: Catalog is the single source of issueClass (A5.1 route 2). Every absence code must have an exact catalog entry (A6.1) carrying derivedFrom and/or proposedBy; proposedBy is a D4 PatternId without test-support imports into lint. Being catalogued is a requirement for absence classification, not a hypothesis.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SINGLE-SOURCE: validate-marketplace single-source rule is at most one under the repository-root skills/ tree only; the packaged mirror (plugins/ngrace/skills/) is excluded (A3.2 §3). Separate assertion that verdicts.md exists and carries all three tokens. Deliberate duplication fails with shown output (§2.7 gate 3).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-GRAPH-COVERAGE: Graph and verification cover every src file this change edits; exceptions for scripts/ (A4.2) and test-support (invariant 7) stated; bun run validate:ci, bun run validate:packed, and bun run ngrace lint --path . green (A5.8 §5). V-M-DOCTOR names src/grace-doctor.test.ts at phase end (A6.5).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DROP-SITE-INVENTORY: Phase report includes the A5.4 drop-site inventory for LintIssue/NgraceIssue (each site file:line marked widened, deliberately not widened with reason, or not on the path) and per-surface reachability of each absence code across lint --format json, doctor, and --assertions target (A5.9; flag name per A6.3).

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: bun test src/grace-doctor.test.ts src/project-utils.test.ts src/test-support/defect-corpus.test.ts src/grace-lint.test.ts
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: issueClass from exact catalog entries on absence emissions in lint JSON; doctor absence-by-reason for the two reachable analysis.* codes; zero case attributed to current-mode skip (A5.2); third code classified under --assertions target on a fixture (A6.2, A6.3); non-absence assertion.* has no absence class (A6.1); single-source rule failing output on deliberate duplication; drop-site inventory and per-surface reachability table; mutation check table; token baseline 636 to new total; un-ignored scripts error count before and after.

Assumptions.Assumption: §2.2 preconditions re-measured on branch base (main @ 0085f32), not assumed: assertion.command-not-evaluated at assertions.ts:263 and :506; analysis.no-adapter catalog guide at catalog.ts:34; analysis.runtime-missing / analysis.adapter-failed ternary at project-utils.ts:330; analysis.no-adapter emission at project-utils.ts:344; bun run validate:ci green; ngrace lint --path . exit 0 with graph module-without-linked-files warnings only; un-ignored scripts/ count 6 governed files, 20 errors. assertion.command-not-evaluated has no exact catalog entry at HEAD (A6.1).
A3–A6 corrections govern where they disagree with provisional §2.5 steps; A4.3 consequence 2 is withdrawn by A5.2.
Path-only modules without LINKS remain warning-level and deliberate (A1 thin tree).

Route 2 does not edit assertions.ts or widen NgraceIssue: classification attaches in withLintIssueGuide from exact catalog entries. M-ASSERTIONS stays out of AffectedAreas unless a later step is forced to edit that file.
